most of balancing is leveraging against what you already have, and making sure you compare to an average example not the best.... like aoe spells in the 3rd level slot should be ~6d6, not 8d6 like fireball an lightning bolt.

then for items you have to determine what they are closest to.  A wand of decay (some form of necrotic damage wand) youd likely want to look at a wand of fireballs as a rough template.

for weapons you look at the average damage, adding about 1/2 to 1 damage for dice over straight modifiers, then compare to existing arms and equips.

the dragontooth dagger damage wise is abotu the same as a dagger +5 due to the +1d6+1 added on.  the +1 to hit is comperable to a 5% higher chance of hitting, this adds about 5% to the damage.

so a +1 weapon that deals 1d4+1d6+1 deals about 8 damage on average.  A flame tongue shortsword (which is relativelly similar) uses attunement, but does 1d6+2d6, and no bonus to to hit, so 12-13 damage on average.  So the question becomes is the lack of attunement on the dagger roughly worht the 4-5 points less of damage
they are roughly balanced, tho i would give the dagger the edge overall for the lack of attunement
